title: parity-rs tenant routing events (0.16.0)
description: tenant.routing.events.<zone>, written in the zone leader's Kafka transactions (read with read_committed). Keyed by tenant id (route.*, assignment.changed, drift.detected), saga id (saga.*) or unit:<name> (unit.changed); `x-key` names it. Saga events carry seq (1, 2, … per saga). Headers: schema_version, traceparent, tenant_id when the body has one, op_id when the body has one.

ev_route_changed.description: A tenant's placement changed (parity-store answered the write). Key: tenant id.

zone.description: A region, zone (= cell), deployment unit (= bin) or media track name (eu1, eu1a, bin-a, blue).

anyOf.description: parity-store's placement fields (CONVENTIONS "Tenant maps"). `cell` names the zone that serves the tenant (zone = cell); records written before 2026-11-03 hold the region in `zone`, `home_zone` and `failover_zone`. parity-rs writes zone = home_zone = cell.
